calls.title: Review Copy for Key Web Pages
calls.summary: The meeting centered on the website relaunch that prioritizes high-traffic pages to improve user experience and align with brand values, especially highlighting the experimentation page. This page is designed to offer a clear overview of GrowthBook's capabilities, emphasizing speed in running experiments and the importance of modularity for enterprise clients. Discussions included the need for enhanced copy to highlight 'warehouse native' features and the flexibility of GrowthBook’s SDK. Additionally, the importance of communicating the experimentation lifecycle and scaling capabilities was stressed to differentiate from competitors. Visual storytelling was identified as crucial for conveying complex features effectively, ensuring that the content is both accessible and informative for various user levels.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, Feature Flags, Warehouse Native, SQL Metrics, MCP Server, Enterprise Features
calls.action_items:

Incorporate “warehouse native” prominently in the experimentation page’s hero section (04:00)
Add a clear section outlining phased GrowthBook adoption (starting with analysis, then deployment) on the experimentation page (09:40)
Rename the statistics section headline to emphasize “state-of-the-art statistics engine” (13:30)
Coordinate inclusion of SQL-based customizable metrics messaging alongside warehouse-native benefits (19:00)
Expand the 'how it works' section to showcase experimental life cycle, organizational scaling, governance, and democratization (21:30)
Plan creation of a 'wide GrowthBook' page for more philosophical, enterprise, and programmatic messaging (29:00)
Work on visuals plan, including animated metrics and experiment list demos, possibly by extracting snippets from product demos (31:45)
Adjust engineering page messaging to emphasize integration with trusted tech brands and world-class dev tools (45:00)
Integrate SOC 2 and security badges with simple self-hosting benefits for engineering page (56:00)
Place enterprise-focused content toward bottom sections or separate detail pages (39:00)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Collect and integrate thoughts on whether 'experiment anywhere' messaging should emphasize SDK flexibility and custom tooling (07:00)
Document feedback on trust messaging and blending statistics jargon appropriately (11:20)
Outline potential animations or visuals for SQL metric definition and experiment lifecycle (32:00)
Lead visuals discussion sessions with Karen and Graham for detailed animation creation (36:30)
Review messaging for MCP integration and collaboration tool alignment; suggest differentiation for PM vs engineering pages (53:00)

**Jeremy Dorn**
